_comment: Owner-curated EVENT CALENDAR for the tracked universe (Scanner / tradeable-rec-inputs item 4). NOT a secret — checked in for git-reviewed provenance, same shape and operational story as universe.json (edit + restart; no hot-reload). EXISTS BECAUSE: Massive/Polygon's earnings feed (list_benzinga_earnings) is a separate add-on our plan is NOT entitled to (probed 2026-07-27), and scheduled macro events are not a Massive product at all. Owner-curated config decouples the calendar from the vendor entirely, which is the more robust outcome regardless of entitlement.
_honesty_contract: ABSENT IS NOT NONE. A symbol with NO entry under 'symbols' means WE DO NOT KNOW its schedule — it must NEVER be rendered or reasoned about as 'no earnings scheduled'. A symbol present with an EMPTY events list means the opposite: someone checked and there is nothing scheduled in the horizon. These are different claims and the loader keeps them distinct (None vs []). Any consumer that collapses them is wrong.
_staleness_contract: An earnings calendar rots fast. 'as_of' is the date the owner last verified this file; consumers MUST surface its age and treat entries past 'horizon_end' as expired rather than silently stale. A quarterly-refreshed file six months old is actively misleading — worse than an empty one.

_schema_example._note: SHAPE ONLY — ignored by the loader (every _-prefixed key is). Not data.
